messages:
Priya Kapoor: Hi everyone  I tried to complete the Okta setup from the welcome email but it immediately says 'account mismatch'. I think my browser auto-picked my personal google account. Also 1Password shows I don't have a seat yet. What's the fastest unblock so I can see onboarding docs?

Sam (IT): Welcome Priya! Super common. Two quick things to try: 1) open the Okta link in an incognito/private window, 2) or sign out of all Google accounts first. If that fails I can reissue the invite to a +work alias or flip on the account chooser. Do you have a security key yet or only phone MFA?

Priya Kapoor: Only phone MFA for now. I tried private window and it still redirected to the mismatch page. My company email is priya.kapoor@redwood.com but I also use priya.kapoor.work@gmail.com personally sometimes.

Sam (IT): Ok. I'll reprovision the invite to priya.kapoor+rwk@gmail.com to avoid auto-selection. Also I'll add a temporary Drive share so you can access docs while we sort the Okta flow.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #5521 created -> IT:okta assigned to Sam. ETA ~3 hours.

Diego (People Ops): Priya, I approved your 1Password seat (ticket #5523). Sam, could you confirm that you add her to the "new-hires-2026" group so seats sync?

Lina (Manager): Confirmed from my side. Welcome Priya :tada: I've requested view access to the team onboarding folder for you. If anything else blocks, DM me.

Sam (IT): Done: reprovisioned invite to priya.kapoor+rwk@gmail.com and added a provisional Drive share (Viewer). 1Password seat is queued, group sync should finish within 10 minutes. We'll mail a YubiKey to the address on file; use phone MFA until it arrives.

Priya Kapoor: I can access the Drive folder now and saw the 1Password invite. Thanks! Quick Q  is there a short doc for adding the YubiKey and passkeys later?

Sam (IT): Yep  see /handbook/it/onboarding -> "SSO & MFA setup". Quick commands if you want to try now:
```
- In Okta: Profile -> Security Methods -> Add Security Key
- Follow browser prompt (allow USB or TouchID)
- If using macOS Chrome, allow the browser to use the device
```
If anything fails DM me and Ill remote in.

Priya Kapoor: Great, all good for now. Thanks everyone!
